rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Wales sun damu da kama su da kallon mutum-mutumi.
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai tashin hankali a tsakanin wasu AMs da aka ba da shawarar canza sunansu zuwa MWPs (Mamba na Majalisar Welsh ta Welsh).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a fadin faɗin faɗin siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya haifar da kunya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce rukunin sa na damuwa ne "yana daidaita da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kaho.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na Plaid ya ce rukunin bai ji dadin hakan ba kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyi.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani konsafetifu na Welsh ya ce rukunin sa na "mai bude zuciya ne" game da canjin suna, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tsalle na baki daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana magana da shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u na Ingilishi na Yorkshire.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wacce a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokoki don gabatar da canje-canjen suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan kowane bayanin abin da ake kira 'yan majalisar za a yanke ne a hannun 'yan majalisar da kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba Majalisar Welsh damar canza sunanta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wata tattaunawa ta jama'a kan shawarwarin da ta samu goyon baya mai fadi wajen kiran taron a matsayin Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan al'amuran sunan AMs, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami goyon baya mafi yawa a cikin tattaunawa ta jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: Ana zargin AMs suna ba da wasu zabin, amma gwagwarmayar cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisa, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kudurin doka kan canje-canjen cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar da ta shafi gyare-gyaren za ta hada da sauran gyare-gyaren hanyoyin da majalisar ke yi, ciki har da ka’idojin da suka shafi dakatar da mambobin (AMs) da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar za su samu karshe a kan yadda za a kira su idan sun yi muhawara kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa sun tafi zabe a wani kuri'ar canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su yi zabe ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewacin Macedonia."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar shugaban kasa ne da nufin warware takaddamar da ta dade tsakanin kasashen biyu makwabta, Girka, wadda ke da lardin da ake kira Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi tsayin daka cewa sunan makwabtansu na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankunansu kuma ta ci gaba da nuna adawa da neman su na shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya kasance mai adawa da kuri'ar raba gardama kan sauya sunan kasar, ya bayyana cewa zai yi watsi da wannan kuri'ar.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaben, ciki har da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa canza sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: An yi shiru a cikin kararrawar St. Martin kamar yadda majami'u ke gwagwarmaya a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane kusurwa," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu wani abu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce rashin gidajen giya ya zama dole.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane a yanzu suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyoyi daban-daban"
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "Bars ba su zama dakunan zama na unguwa ba inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da coci, yana damuwa cewa kudin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba har sai shugabanni sun yi tsammanin hakan, "kuma ba da daɗewa ba za su koma inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Makarantun, ya kara da cewa, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-ginen gidaje da cibiyoyin da za su cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran masallatai na unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da ke siyan gidaje a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance fari," ya ce, "sannan za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan coci-coci za su rufe gaba ɗaya domin ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin waɗannan mutanen da za su koma waɗannan gidaje za su zama membobin waɗannan coci-coci."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: An gina majami'u biyu da gungun jama'a masu fata kafin Harlem ya zama babban birnin bakar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Jama'ar Methodist na asali sun bar a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar baki da suka yi ibada a kusa da su sun karbi mallakar ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki St. Martin aiki da shi ta wata kungiyar bakar fata a karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci wata zanga-zangar da ta shafi masu sayar da kayayyaki a kan titin 125, babbar titin sayar da kayayyaki a Harlem, wadanda suka ki daukar bakar fata ko kuma suka yi musu kaca-kaca.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ya yi mummunar barna a ginin, amma yayin da mabiya cocin Father Johnson suka fara shirin sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mai Rabaran David Johnson, ɗan Mai Rabaran Johnson da magajinsa a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da kiran kararrawa "agogo marasa kuɗi."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya yi wasan kaho a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu dabam: "Kasadar al'adu" da "na'urar tarihi marar maye."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ɗalibi, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da 'yan luwadi suka yi wasa, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babbar motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin's a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu zanen kaya da masu aikin gini, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar - tana kula da al'umma, wacce ta kunshi shugabannin da ba na addini ba - ta rubuta cocin a watan Yuli da damuwa cewa cocin "za ta yi ƙoƙarin watsa farashi" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zanen kaya da masu gini da cocin ta aika ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu mabiya cocin sun yi korafi da rashin gaskiya a bangaren cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifin shark ya raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don kama lobster a California.
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: Wani kifin shark ya raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar, yayin da yake nutsewa don kama kifi a California a ranar farko ta kakar kama kifi, jami'ai sun ce.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.output: Harin ya faru da misalin karfe 7 na safe a kusa da bakin tekun Beacon's Beach a Encinitas.
rows.reference: Harin ya faru ne kawai kafin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da Bakin Tekun Beacon a cikin Encinitas.

rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa yana nutsewa tare da abokai kusan rabin sa'a a ranar Asabar da safe lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kira don taimako, sai suka yi ta shawagi zuwa wurinsa tare da taimakawa wajen ceto shi daga cikin ruwa.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel ya fada wa gidan talabijin na KSWB-TV a San Diego yana iyo ne tare da abokansa na kusan rabin sa’a a ranar Asabar da safe a lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kururuwa shi ke nan sai ya nufi wurin tare da wani gungun mutane don su jawo shi waje daga ruwan.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin kawai farin ciki ne na kama lobster, sai ya gane cewa yana ihu, "Na kama!
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.output: Na ji rauni!
rows.reference: An cije ni!’

rows.output: An yanke masa dukkan kashin bayansa,” in ji Hammel da ya ce da zarar ya isa yaron.
rows.reference: An buɗe kashin kafaɗarsa gaba ɗaya,” inji Hammel da ya gani a lokacin da isa wurin yaron.

rows.output: "Naji dadin kowa ya fita daga ruwa: 'Akwai kifi a cikin ruwa!'" Hammel ya kara da cewa.
rows.reference: “Na yi ihu ga kowa don su fita daga ruwan. Hammel ya ƙara da cewa, ‘Akwai babban kifin teku a cikin ruwan!”

rows.output: An tashi yaron zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady a San Diego inda yake cikin mawuyacin hali.
rows.reference: An ɗauki yaron a cikin jirgin sama zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady da ke cikin San Diego inda aka jera shi a yanayi mai tsanani.

rows.output: Jinsin kifin kifi da ke da alhakin harin ba a san shi ba.
rows.reference: Ba a san irie-iren jinsunan babban kifin tekun da ya yi wannan harin ba.

rows.output: Jami'in tsaron ruwa Capt. Larry Giles ya bayyana a wani taron manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifin kifi a yankin makonni kadan da suka gabata, amma an tantance cewa ba wani nau'in kifin da ke da hatsarin gaske ba ne.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Larry Giles mai kula da rayuwa ya ce a gaban maneman labarai cewa an ga wani babban kifin teku a cikin yankin ‘yan makonni baya, amma an ƙudurta cewa ba daga wani jinsuna ne babban kifi mai haɗari ne ba.

rows.output: Giles ya kara wa wanda aka azabtar da raunin da ya yi illa a yankin kirji.
rows.reference: Giles ya kara da cewa wanda abin da ya shafa ya ji raunuka munana a kan yankin sama na gadon bayansa.

rows.output: Jami'ai sun rufe hanyar shiga bakin teku daga Ponto Beach a Casablanca zuwa Swami's a Encinitas na tsawon sa'o'i 48 domin gudanar da bincike da kuma dalilai na tsaro.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun rufe iso ga bakin tekun daga Bakin Tekun Ponto na cikin Casablad zuwa Swami's a cikin Ecinitas na sa’o’i 48 don dalilan bincike da kariya.

rows.output: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da nau'ikan kifin kifi 135 a yankin, amma mafi yawa ba a dauke su a matsayin masu haɗari ba.
rows.reference: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da jinsunan 135 na manyan kifin teku a cikin yankin, amma mafi yawa ba a ɗauka suna da haɗari.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kyawun Birtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's yana fafatawa da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da kantin kayan kwalliya irin na kantin sayar da kayayyaki, tare da masu taimakon kwararru.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na babban tura cikin kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya mai darajar £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan gida ke komawa baya, manyan kogin kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin kasar, kuma za a kai su cikin karin shaguna na shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawun ya zo ne yayin da manyan kantunan ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin saman da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talabijin, microwave, da kayan daki.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyar sa zuwa samfurori 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.output: Wadannan nau'ikan, ciki har da L'Oreal, Maybelline, da Burt's Bees, za su kuma samu karin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yiwa lakabi irin wadanda ake samu a shagunan kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayayyaki na kuma sake farfado da layin kayan shafa na Boutique domin mafi yawan kayayyakin su kasance masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake bukata sosai da matasa masu siyayya ke nema.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da ƙamshi, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shagunan a cikin shaguna biyu na Sainsbury, na farko da aka buɗe a Croydon, kudu London, a makon da ya gabata, yayin da na biyu za a buɗe a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a ƙarshen wannan shekara.

rows.output: Daniel Sturridge ya ceci Liverpool daga rashin nasara a gasar Premier ta hanyar zura kwallo a raga a minti na 89 a ranar Asabar a filin wasa na Stamford Bridge da ke Landan.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge ya kare Liverpool daga wani wasa kofin ƙalubale na Premier League inda ya yi hasara ga Chelsea tare da ci a cikin mintina na 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge a cikin Landan.

rows.output: Sturridge ya karɓi wani watsawa daga Xherdan Shaqiri, kusan mita 30 daga ƙwallon Chelsea, yayin da ƙungiyarsa ke faɗuwa da ci 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya karɓi wani turo ƙwallo daga Xherdan Shaqiri kusan yadina 30 a waje daga cin Chelsea tare da ‘yan ƙungiyarsa da suke biye ci 1 da 0.

rows.output: Ya buga kwallon zuwa hagu kafin ya ciro wani harbi zuwa kusurwar kasa.
rows.reference: Ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa hagun ɗinsa kafin ya yi wani bugu zuwa matsaya mai nisa.

rows.output: Ƙoƙarin ya yi sama da akwatin yayin da yake tafiya zuwa kusurwar dama ta sama ta hanyar raga.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin ya ɗagu sama da akwatin inda ya gangara zuwa saman kusurwar dama na ragar.

rows.output: Kwallon ta fadi a karshe a kan Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle da kuma shiga cikin raga.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe ƙwallon ta faɗo a saman Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle inda kuma ta faɗa cikin ragar.

rows.output: "Na yi ƙoƙari kawai in shiga wannan matsayi, in samu kwallon kuma 'yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe suna wasa gaba gwargwadon yiwuwa, don haka na yi ƙoƙarin ƙirƙirar lokacin da zan iya."
rows.reference: Sturridge ya faɗa a LiverpoolFC.com cewa “Kawai wani ƙoƙari ne na shiga wannan wurin, na samun ƙwallon kuma ‘yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe wasa suke yi a gaba yadda zai yiwu, don haka na yi kawai ƙoƙari ne na ƙirƙira wa kaina wani lokaci yadda zai yiwu.”

rows.output: Na ga Kante yana zuwa sai na yi taɓawa da sauri na kuma ban yi tunani a kai ba na kuma na yi harbin.

rows.output: Chelsea ta jagoranci 1-0 a lokacin hutun rabin lokaci bayan da ta ci a minti na 25 daga Eden Hazard dan kasar Belgium.

rows.output: Haka kuma ina roƙon kowa, musamman direbobin tasi, idan suna da kowane bidiyo da aka ɗauka a cikin dashcam ɗin su su tuntube mu domin watakila suna da bayani mai mahimmanci ga bincikenmu.

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka samu gawar ta fito daga garin Birkenhead kuma an same ta a cikin wani gida.

rows.output: Hukuncin wulakanci zai zama adalci mai dacewa ga kawar da kayan al'adu da addini da yawa na Ingila da magoya bayan Puritan masu sha'awar sa suka yi.

rows.output: Yahaya Goldsmith, shugaban kungiyar Cromwell Society, ya ce: "Ya zama wajibi a cikin muhawarar da ake yi a yanzu kan cire sarakunan da siffar Oliver Cromwell a wajen fadar Westminster ta zama abin da ake nema."
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, shugaban Al’ummar Cromwell, ya ce: “Ba za a iya gujewa a cikin mahawarar da ake yi yanzu ba game da cire mutum-mutumi cewa surar Oliver Cromwell a wajen Fadar Westminster za ta zama wani abin da ake hari.

rows.output: Juyin juya halin da aka yi a Ingila ba a umarta ba, kuma ba a yi ta da hannun Cromwell ba.

rows.output: Wataƙila an yi wa Cromwell ba daidai ba an yi masa sadaukarwa don ayyukan kakansa Thomas a ƙarni na baya.
rows.reference: Watakila abu mummunan da za a ga bayan Cromwell a kansa shi ne ayyukan da kakansa Thomas ya yi a cikin ƙarni da ya wuce.

rows.output: Wani abin ban mamaki na Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft na Cromwell yana nuna ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihi na wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin har yanzu yana da daraja a murna.
rows.reference: Akwai babbar bayani game da Cromwell na Sa William Hamo Thorneycroft da ke zama hujjar ra’ayi na karni na 19 wanda kuma ɓangare na ilimin bayanan tarihin na wani sananne wanda mafi yawa suka yi imani har yanzu ya kamata a yi murna a kansa.

rows.output: Mista Goldsmith ya gaya wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin shi ne mai kare majalisar dokoki da yawa, watakila a karshen karni na 19 fiye da yau, a kan matsin lamba daga waje, a halin yanzu ba shakka sarauta.
rows.reference: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa a jaridar The Sunday Telegraph: “Mutane da yawa suna ɗaukan Cromwell, watakila sosai a shekarun karshe na karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin rikicin ba makawa da mulkin sarauta.

rows.output: Shin wannan yana nufin cewa an yi wani ingantaccen bayani game da shi, ko kuma an yi wani abu daidai? Wannan batu ne na ci gaba da tattaunawar tarihi.
rows.reference: Ko wancan bayanin zai zama wani abu gaba ɗaya daidai ya zama batun na ci gaba da mahawara ta fuskar tarihi.

rows.output: Wani abu mai tabbaci shi ne cewa rikicin da ya faru a tsakiyar karni na 17 ya tsara ci gaban da ya biyo baya na kasarmu, kuma Cromwell mutum ne mai iya ganewa wanda ke wakiltar daya daga cikin bangarorin da suka rabu.
rows.reference: Abin da ke da tabbaci shi ne rikicin na tsakiyar ƙarni na 17 ya gyara ci gaba na ƙasarmu da aka samu daga baya, kuma Cromwell wani mutum ne sananne da aka sani wanda ke wakiltar sashe ɗaya na wancan rikicin.

rows.reference: Rosa tana da iska ta mil 85 a cikin sa’a, wani Nau’i na 1 na Guguwar, a lokaci na ƙarfe 5 na safe a ranar Lahadi lokaci na Gabashi, kuma an gan ta a mil 385 na kudu-maso-yamma na Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa za ta yi tafiya zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin Rosa za ta motsa zuwa arewa a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, wani rami yana fara samuwa a kan Tekun Pasifik kuma yana tafiya gabas zuwa Gabar Tekun Amurka. Yayin da Rosa ke gabatowa kan gabar tekun Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin guguwar tropikal, za ta fara tura zurfin danshi na tropikal zuwa yankin kudu maso yammacin Amurka.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin nan, wata akalar ruwan ta fara kankama a saman Tekun Pacific inda ta motsa gabas zuwa Bakin Teku na Yamma na Amurka. Kamar yadda Rosa ke tunkaran zirin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin wani babban haɗari za ta fara tura laimar zafi zuwa yankin arewaci cikin kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka.

rows.output: Rosa za ta kawo ruwan sama mai yawa har zuwa inci 10 a wasu sassan kasar Mexico a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Rosa za ta haifar da har kusan inci 10 na ruwan sama a sassan Mexico a ranar Litinin.

rows.output: Sannan, danshi na wurare masu zafi yana mu'amala da gagarumin guguwar da ke gabatowa zai haifar da ruwan sama mai yawa a duk fadin yankin Kudu maso Yamma a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan, laimar zafin idan ta haɗu tare da akalar ruwa da ke fuskantowa za ta ƙirƙiri wani ruwan sama da zai isa wurare masu yawa a cikin kudu-maso-yamma a kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.output: A cikin gida, milimita 25 zuwa 100 na ruwan sama zai haifar da ambaliya mai hatsari, guguwar ƙazanta, da yuwuwar ambaliya a cikin hamada.
rows.reference: A cikin gida, inci 1 zuwa 14 na ruwan sama zai haifar da mummunan ambaliya, kwararar burbushi da kuma yiwuwar zaizayar ƙasa a cikin hamadar.

rows.output: Zafin danshin wurare masu zafi zai haifar da yawan ruwan sama da zai kai inci 2 zuwa 3 a kowace awa a wasu wurare, musamman a sassa na kudancin Nevada da Arizona.
rows.reference: Matsananciyar laimar zafi za ta iya haifar da kimomin ruwan sama da zai fuskanci incina 2 zuwa 3 a kowace sa’a a cikin wuraren, musamman a cikin sassa na kudancin Nevada da Arizona.

rows.output: An yi hasashen ruwan sama tsakanin inci 2 zuwa 4 a wasu sassan Kudu maso Yamma, musamman a kan mafi yawan yankin Arizona.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin inci 2 zuwa 4 na ruwan sama a sassan kudu-maso-yamma, musamman a mafi yawanci na Arizona.

rows.output: Hatsarin ambaliyar ruwa na iya faruwa tare da yanayi yana da sauri ya lalace saboda yanayin bazuwar ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun ambaliya ruwa ba ƙaƙƙautawa saboda yanda lalacewar yanayi ke ci gaba da ta'azzara saboda irin yadda ruwan sama ke sauka a yanki mai zafi yake jifa-jifa.

rows.output: Yana da matukar rashin hankali a yi kokarin tafiya cikin hamada da kanku tare da hadarin ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi.
rows.reference: Mummunan shawara ne a fita zuwa cikin hamada da kafa ganin barazanar ruwan saman na wuri mai zafin.

rows.output: Hakan na iya haifar da kwaruruka su zama koguna masu tayar da hankali, kuma guguwar guguwa za ta kawo iska mai karfi a yankin da kuma busasshiyar iska.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawan zai iya haifar da kwazazzabai su zama koguna masu gudu kuma cidar ruwa za ta haifar da iska mai ƙura da kaɗa ƙura.

rows.output: Tasirin da zai biyo baya zai kawo ruwan sama mai yawa a wasu sassan gabar tekun Kudancin California.
rows.reference: Akalar ruwan saman da ke fuskantowa za ta jawo ruwan sama mai yawa ta gida zuwa ga sassa na bakin teku na Kudancin California.

rows.output: Yawan ruwan sama sama da rabin inci na iya faruwa, wanda zai iya haifar da ƙananan guguwa da kuma hanyoyin da ba su da kyau.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun jimillar ruwan sama na sama da wani inci, wanda zai haifar da ɗan ƙaramin kwararar burbushi kuma hanyoyin mota su yi santsi.

rows.output: Wannan zai zama kashi na farko na ruwan sama a wannan yanki a lokacin damina.
rows.reference: Wannan zai zama ruwan sama na farko na lardin na lokacinsu na damuna.

rows.output: Wasu ruwan sama na ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi za su fara kusantar Arizona a karshen Lahadi da farkon Litinin, kafin ruwan sama ya zama mai yaduwa a karshen Litinin da Talata.
rows.reference: Wani ruwan sama jifa-jifa na wurin zafi zai fara fuskantowa Arizona a makare ranar Lahadi da farkon ranar Litinin, kafin ruwan saman zai zama ya bazu da yawa ranar Litinin a makare da Talata.

rows.output: Za a bazu da ruwan sama mai nauyi zuwa Hudu a ranar Talata kuma zai dawwama har zuwa Laraba.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawa zai bazu a cikin Kusurwowi Huɗu a ranar Talata har ya kai cikin Laraba.

rows.output: Oktoba na iya ganin wasu canje-canje masu tsanani a zafin jiki a fadin Amurka yayin da Arctic ke sanyaya, amma tropics na kasancewa da dumi.
rows.reference: Watan Oktoba zai iya ganin wani tsananin yanayi mai juyawa a faɗin Amurka kamar yadda Arctic ke ƙara sanyi, amma kuma wurare masu zafin za su ci gaba da kasancewa da dumi.

rows.output: Wani lokaci hakan yana haifar da canje-canje masu ban mamaki a zafin jiki a cikin nisa mai guntu.
rows.reference: A wasu lokutan wannan zai kai ga canje-canje masu ban mamaki a cikin yanayi na wasu lokuta gajeru.

rows.output: Akwai babban misali na bambance-bambancen yanayi mai ban mamaki a tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Akwai wani babban misali na bambance-bambancen yanayi mai ban mamaki ta cikin tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Akwai kusan bambancin zafin jiki na digiri 20 tsakanin Kansas City, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da kuma tsakanin St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Akwai kusan wani bambancin yanayi na digiri 20 tsakanin  Birnin Kansas, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da tsakanin  St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.

rows.output: A cikin kwanaki masu zuwa, dumi-duminsa na bazara zai yi ƙoƙarin gina shi da faɗaɗa shi kuma.
rows.reference: A ‘yan kwanaki masu zuwa, ɗumin lokacin zafi zai yi ƙoƙari ya ginu da sake faɗaɗa.

rows.output: Yankin tsakiyar da gabashin Amurka na iya tsammanin fara watan Oktoba mai dumi tare da 80s a fadin Kudancin Yamma zuwa sassan Arewa maso Gabas.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin yawancin tsakiya da gabashin Amurka za ta ga wani ɗumi da zai fara zuwa Oktoba tare da bazuwar 80s daga Sararin Kudanci zuwa ga sassa na Arewa-maso-gabas.

rows.output: Birnin New York zai iya kaiwa digiri 80 a ranar Talata, wanda zai kasance kusan digiri 10 sama da matsakaici.
rows.reference: Birnin New York zai iya kai wa digiri 80a ranar Talata, wanda aƙalla ya kai digiri 10 a sama matsakaici.

rows.output: Hasashen yanayi na dogon lokaci namu yana nuna babban damar samun yanayin zafi fiye da matsakaici ga gabashin Amurka a cikin rabin farko na watan Oktoba.
rows.reference: Hasashen yanayin namu mai tsawo yana nuna babban kintace yiwuwar matsakaicin yanayi na sama don gabashin Amurka a cikin farkon rabin Oktoba.

rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 sun kalla shari'ar Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli jin bahasi na Brett Kavanaugh

rows.output: An kiyasta mutane sama da miliyan 20 sun kalli shaidar da aka yi a ranar Alhamis da kotun koli ta zaba Brett Kavanaugh da kuma zargin da ake yi masa na fyade da ake zarginsa da aikatawa a shekarun 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwa guda shida na talabijin.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli shaida mai riƙewa daga wanda aka tura sunan don kujerar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da matar da ke ƙararsa a kan cin zarafi na jima’i da ake cewa ya faru a cikin shekaru na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar gidajen talabijin guda shida.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, rikicin siyasa ya ci gaba da tafiya, inda masu watsa shirye-shirye ke dakatar da shirye-shiryen yau da kullum don kammala minti na karshe na ranar Juma'a: yarjejeniyar da Sanata Jeff Flake na Arizona ya tsara na hukumar FBI ta gudanar da bincike na mako guda kan zargin.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin haka, rikicin siyasar ya ci gaba, tare da masu yada labarai suna katsse shirin da ake yi na kullum don wani sauyi da aka yi na ranar Jumu’a a makare: wata yarjejeniya da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya haifar don Hukumar FBI ta yi wani bincike na mako guda na tuhume-tuhumen.

rows.output: Ford ta gaya wa Majalisar Shari'a ta Majalisar Dattawa cewa tana da kashi 100 na tabbacin cewa Kavanaugh ya taɓa ƙafafunta da gangan kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin cire kayan aikinta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.
rows.reference: Ford ya faɗa a Kwamitin Shari’a na Majalisar Dattijai cewa tana da tabbaci kashi 100 cewa Kavanaugh ta cakume ta yana cikin maye kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin cire mata tufafinta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaida mai ƙarfi, ya tabbatar da cewa ba ta faru ba.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaida mai ɓacin rai, ya ce yana tabbaci kashi 100 cewa abin bai faru ba.

rows.output: Wataƙila fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 da Nielsen ya ruwaito a ranar Juma'a sun kalla.
rows.reference: Ba mamaki fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 ne a rahoton Nielsen suka kalli abin.

rows.output: Kamfanin yana ƙididdige matsakaicin masu kallo a CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.
rows.reference: Kamfanin ya lasafta matsakaicin yawan masu kallo ne ta CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.

rows.output: Ba a samu kididdiga nan take ga wasu hanyoyin sadarwa da suka watsa shi ba, ciki har da PBS, C-SPAN, da Fox Business Network.
rows.reference: Ba a sami alƙaluma ba nan da nan ga sauran hanyoyin sadarwa da suka nuna abin, da suka haɗa da PBS, C-SPAN da Fox Business Network ɗin.

rows.output: Kuma Nielsen yawanci yana da wasu matsaloli wajen auna mutanen da ke kallon ofisoshi.
rows.reference: Kuma Nielsen yawanci yana samun matsala ta auna mutane da suka kalla a cikin ofisoshinsu.

rows.output: Don sanya hakan cikin hangen nesa, girman taron yana kama da wanda wasan karshe na kwallon kafa ko kuma lambar yabo ta Academy.
rows.reference: Don a fito da abin a fili, wancan shi ne kamar girman yawan masu kallo a wasan ƙwallo na wa ka ci ka tashiko ba da Kyaututtukan Academy.

rows.output: Tashar Labarai ta Fox, wacce masu sharhin ra'ayinta suka goyi bayan nada Kavanaugh sosai, ta jagoranci dukkan tashoshin da kashi 5.69 miliyan masu kallo a lokacin sauraren da aka yi gabaɗaya, in ji Nielsen.
rows.reference: Tashar Fox News, wadda masu gabatar da ra’ayi sun matukar goyi bayan ɗaukan na Kavanaugh, inda ya jagoranci dukkan hanyoyin sadarwa da ke da matsakaicin masu kallo miliyan 5.69 a lokacin jin bahasin da duk ranar, inji Nielsen.

rows.output: ABC ta zo na biyu da mutane 3.26 miliyan.
rows.reference: ABC ita ce ta biyu mai masu kallo miliyan 3.26.

rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa CBS ta kasance miliyan 3.1, NBC miliyan 2.94, MSNBC miliyan 2.89 da CNN miliyan 2.52.
rows.reference: CBS tana da miliyan 3.1, NBC miliyan 2.94, MSNBC miliyan 2.89 da CNN mai miliyan 2.52, inji Nielsen.

rows.output: An ci gaba da sha'awar bayan zaman.
rows.reference: Sha’awa ta kasance ta yi sama bayan sauraron.

rows.output: Flake ita ce babbar jaruma a cikin wasan kwaikwayo na Juma'a.
rows.reference: Flake shi ne sananne a tsakiya a cikin diramar Juma’ar.

rows.output: Bayan ofishin Republican mai matsakaici ya fitar da wata sanarwa cewa zai kada kuri'a a kan Kavanaugh, an kama shi da kyamarori na CNN da CBS a ranar Juma'a da safe yana fuskantar zanga-zangar masu zanga-zangar yayin da yake kokarin hawa lif zuwa wani taron kwamitin shari'a.
rows.reference: Bayan ofishin ‘yan Republican mai matsakaicin ra’ayi ya fitar da wata jawabi cewa zai zaɓi Kavanaugh, kyamarorin CNN da CBS sun nuna shi a ranar Jumu’a yana ihu a masu zanga-zanga a lokacin da yake ƙoƙarin hawa na’urar ɗaukan mutane zuwa saman bene zuwa ga wurin taron Kwamiti a kan Shari’a.

rows.output: Ya tsaya yana kallon ƙasa na wasu mintuna da yawa yana fuskantar su, yayin da ake suka, ana watsa shi kai tsaye a CNN.
rows.reference: Ya tsaya da idanuwa a ƙasa na tsawon mintina masu yawa a yayin da ake yi masa ihu, ana nunawa a talabijin na CNN.

rows.output: "Na tsaya a nan a gabanku," wata mace ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ina tsaye a nan a gabanka,” inji wata mata.

rows.output: Shin kuna ganin yana faɗin gaskiya ga ƙasar?
rows.reference: “Kana jin yana faɗan gaskiya ne ga ƙasar?

rows.output: An gaya masa, "kana da karfi idan akwai matan da ba su da karfi."
rows.reference: An gaya masa, “kana da dukkan ƙarfi a lokacin da mata da yawa ba su da ƙarfi.””

rows.output: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar da wata sanarwa, ya ce kafin lif ya rufe cewa zai kara magana a taron kwamitin.
rows.reference: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar wani bayani kuma ya ce, kafin na’urar ɗaukan mutanen ta rufe, cewa yana da abu mai yawa da zai faɗa a wurin bahasin kwamitin.

rows.output: An kuma rufe shi da kuma hanyoyin watsa shirye-shirye, sa'o'i masu rai daga baya, lokacin da Majalisar Dokoki ta shirya kada kuri'a don ci gaba da nada Kavanaugh zuwa Majalisar Dattawa don kada kuri'a.
rows.reference: Hanyoyin sadarwa na kebul da masu watsawa dukka suna yaɗa abin lokacin da ake yi sa’o’i daga baya, a lokacin da Kwamitin Shari’ar ke kaɗa kuri’a don tura ba da sunan Kavanaugh zuwa ga cikekkiyar Majalisar Dattawan don wani kaɗa kuri’ar.

rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi haka ne kawai idan hukumar FBI ta duba zargin da ake yi wa dan takarar na mako guda masu ra'ayin mazan jiya suka yi kira da a yi.
rows.reference: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi kawai hakan ne tare da fahimtar cewa hukumar bincike ta FBI za ta duba kagen a kan wanda aka ba da sunan nasa a mako mai zuwa, wanda ‘yan tsiraru jam’iyyar Democrat suke ta fata.

rows.output: An yi wa Flake ya yi imani da shi, wani bangare, ta hanyar tattaunawa da abokinsa, Sanata Dimokuradiyya Chris Coons.
rows.reference: Flake ya gamsu ɗan kaɗa da hirarraki tare da abokinsa, Sanatan jam’iyyar Democrat Chris Coons.

rows.output: Bayan tattaunawa da Coons da kuma tattaunawa da wasu Sanatoci da dama daga baya, Flake ya yanke shawararsa.
rows.reference: Bayan wata hira tare da Coons da sanatoci masu yawa daga baya, Flake ya yanke hukuncinsa.

rows.output: Ndị AM na Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka ihe nkiri."
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Ụjọ dị n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs n'ihi na a tụrụ aro ka a gbanwee aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko omeiwu Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ na-ebilite n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe ọdịdị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọpụta ọchị.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na-ada ụda na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'ime Welsh, twp pụtara onye ara na pwp pụtara ihe mkpofu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ dum "adịghị ahụkebe" ma tụọ aro ụzọ ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka nchekwa Welsh kwuru na òtù ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana ọ na-ekwu na ọ bụ obere ịwụ elu okwu site na MWP gaa na Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'ọnọdụ a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka otu ndị si Yorkshire English na-ekwu mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọgbakọ ahụ, nke na-ede ugbu a iwu iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ banyere ihe ọ bụla a ga-akpọ ndị otu Ụlọ ahụ ga-adabere n'aka ndị otu ahụ n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Gọọmentị Wales 2017 nyere ọchịchị Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, kọmishọna ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke nzukọ ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ụlọ ọgbakọ a Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọn ahụ tụrụ anya ndị òtù Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, ma nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha n'ịgbasa ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AM na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọgụ iji nweta nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ isi ihe na-akpata nsogbu nye onye isi oche, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eziga ụkpụrụ iwu maka mgbanwe n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe a ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otu esi arụ ọrụ nke ụlọ ahụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara nkwụsị nke AMs na nhazi usoro kọmitii.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enweta votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha ga-akpọ mgbe ha na-eme mkparịta ụka na iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ààrẹ Macedonian Gjorge Ivanov, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ alátakò ìdìbò gbogbogbò tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú yíyí orúkọ náà, ti sọ pé òun yóò kọ̀ láti bọ̀wọ̀ fún ìdìbò náà.
